rule: This file records where shared English learning/runtime work should continue. It is not exam/source truth, private learner state, or a substitute for the Learning Contract and module owners.
completed_shared_work: English capability architecture is frozen as Lexical / Reading / Translation / Writing plus task-specific trainers.
Objective Runtime v1 is frozen for Reading A / Cloze / Reading B: learner-Chat review is passage/set-level while item-level objects remain internal evidence.
Objective Evidence / Transfer Runtime v1 tracks repair threads / transfer claims rather than historical questions; later fresh transfer outranks same-item correction.
Reading A Current no longer loads legacy per-question WATCH transfer components; Lexical/Reading roots route outward instead of being duplicated inside task stores.
Cloze and Reading B Current runtimes are source-bound to canonical Current data with answer-gated clean attempts, whole-unit handoff, navigation, transfer claim import, and validation gates.
Objective first-learning has one canonical owner at content/english/modules/objective-learning.md and is rendered directly at /objective-learn/ without duplicating semantic content in Astro.

Objective first-learning follows the Translation asset philosophy: Objective Global Map -> task-specific dense Core Learning Blocks -> Skill Maps as diagnostic addresses -> high-value Deep Skill Content -> Runtime.

Static asset policy is now frozen as COMPLETE-BUT-SKIPPABLE: stable, frequent, generalizable teaching content should be written clearly and densely into the static asset even when some learners already know it. Learner proficiency changes the reading path, not the amount of canonical static content.

Fast Track / calibration is therefore a navigation rule only: known mechanisms may be skimmed or skipped; real-task friction sends the learner back to the relevant Core / Skill. It must not be used to thin the canonical asset.

Reading A static content now includes Question Demand, Decisive Evidence and Boundary, Option Proposition, Adjudication/Execution, Skill Map, and deeper stable content for evidence boundary, cause/relation shift, attribution, local-to-global/example-to-claim, true-but-irrelevant, answer-switch discipline, and stop rules.

Cloze static content now includes Slot Demand, five-layer Constraint Stack, Candidate Competition, context expansion and uncertainty execution, Skill Map, and deeper stable content for local-possible vs best-fit, collocation/semantic preference, near-synonym competition, construction authority, and discourse relations.

Reading B static content now includes Discourse Skeleton, Position Demand, Candidate Role/Cohesion, Global Reconciliation, confidence ordering/provisional placement, coupled/cascade analysis, Skill Map, and deeper stable content for local-vs-global fit, coupled placement, and reference chains.

The /objective-learn/ UI now supports fine-grained jump navigation to Core Blocks and Deep Skill sections. Reading A / Cloze / Reading B home pages keep First Learning optional and preserve direct Continue Practice.
Objective QA includes runtime validation plus a dedicated objective-learning validation for canonical owner registration, required Core/Skill anchors, learner-page wiring, and all three home links.

Translation now has an independent learner-facing Productive runtime rather than being only the reference example for first-learning assets; it remains semantically separate from Objective task runtimes.
Translation Current is source-bound to 27 whole task/sets and 135 segments from the canonical question bank. All 27 sets have learner-facing English source text.

Translation reference coverage is explicit rather than fabricated: 25 sets have complete reference coverage, 2 sets are partial, 132/135 segment references are available, and three segment references remain Current pending_review gaps (2022 q48/q49 and 2025 q46).

Translation Runtime implements immutable first translation -> diagnosis/minimal repair -> learner reconstruction -> optional full-reference/deeper comparison. Full reference may be explicitly revealed earlier when genuinely useful, but it is not the default next step after the first attempt.

Translation learner surfaces are active at /translation/, /translation/[id]/, and /translation-learn/. Private attempt/history state stays on-device, whole-task Chat handoff is available, and missing references are surfaced transparently without synthesizing answers.
Translation Current source/contract validation and Astro full-site build are green; real learner-use validation is still required before treating the runtime UX as behaviorally validated.

Translation canonical learning/runtime asset now lives under content/english/modules/translation/learning.md so Translation can grow inside its own module folder without sharing a flat file namespace with other English modules.

Writing now has a Current learner-facing static learning asset at content/english/modules/writing/learning.md with Global Map, dense Core Learning Blocks, Skill Map, starter Skill Content, synthetic training semantics, true-exam protection, and a frozen whole-composition Writing Runtime baseline.
Writing static asset is ready for future learner-page projection; no learner-facing Writing web runtime is claimed ready yet.

objective_tasks.inheritance: First learning uses complete-but-skippable static assets: Global Map -> task Core Blocks -> Skill Map -> stable high-value Deep Skill Content. Practice uses the frozen passage/set-level Objective Runtime. Skill Maps are addresses, not compulsory curricula. Chat owns real ambiguity, interacting mechanisms, learner-specific repair, micro-drills, and semantic transfer adjudication.

translation.inheritance: Translation is an independent Productive lane. First learning uses its dense complete-but-skippable asset. Runtime uses the whole task/set as the learner-facing unit: preserve the first translation, diagnose the first meaningful failure, give only the smallest useful repair/cue, let the learner reconstruct, and reveal full reference only when useful. Missing Current references remain explicit source gaps and must never be fabricated. Stable high-value content belongs in the static asset; adaptive long-tail depth belongs in Chat when real evidence makes it valuable.

writing.inheritance: Writing is an independent Productive lane. First learning uses its Global Map and dense Core Learning Blocks, with Skill Map nodes serving later diagnosis rather than a compulsory curriculum. Formal attempts remain whole-composition units: preserve first meaningful plan/content evidence and first draft, diagnose the first meaningful failure, apply the smallest repair, require learner re-generation, and use later fresh Writing transfer as stronger evidence than same-prompt rewriting.
writing.current_owner_status: Writing-specific canonical static learning/runtime owner is frozen at content/english/modules/writing/learning.md; learner-facing web projection remains future work.

next_action.instruction: Do not add more infrastructure or synthetic teaching content by default. Validate the existing Objective and Translation runtimes through genuine learner use. Keep Writing static content stable until its learner-page projection is intentionally started; do not consume fresh Writing true-exam prompts merely to test static presentation.
learner_validation_sequence: Objective: use the left navigation to skip known First Learning material instead of deleting it from the canonical asset.
Objective: enter a genuine clean passage/set, then route wrong/unanswered/uncertain evidence through whole-unit Chat diagnosis and the existing claim-level transfer flow.
Translation: enter one genuine whole task/set from /translation/ with reference hidden and complete the first translation cleanly.
Translation: preserve the first translation, identify the first meaningful failure, compress repair to at most the useful priority lenses, and reconstruct before default full-reference comparison.
Translation: use explicit early reference reveal only when diagnosis/minimal repair is insufficient; treat reference expression as comparison evidence rather than a unique correct surface form.
For either active runtime lane, stable clean performance passes without manufactured review debt; later fresh material supplies stronger transfer evidence than same-item correction.
Revise static content or runtime UI only from concrete learner friction, missing stable mental models, unclear decision actions, weak examples, bad information density, or poor skip/navigation UX.

do_not_reopen_without_new_evidence: Do not turn Reading A / Cloze / Reading B into question-by-question Chat review systems.
Do not restore per-question WATCH as the durable Reading A transfer object.
Do not close transfer claims from arbitrary N-pass counters.
Do not duplicate Lexical or Reading knowledge inside objective task stores.
Do not make First Learning a compulsory gate before direct practice or Continue.
Do not use learner proficiency as a reason to thin canonical static first-learning content; proficiency should change navigation and skip behavior instead.

Do not confuse complete stable content with an encyclopedia. Rare boundaries, unusual structures, multi-mechanism ambiguity, personalized error patterns, and custom micro-drills remain adaptive Chat territory unless repeated evidence proves they deserve canonical static treatment.
Do not turn Skill Maps into compulsory curricula or teacher question-type taxonomies.
Do not expose formal answers or diagnostic assets before a clean attempt.
Do not merge Translation into Objective taxonomy or reuse Objective item-level review semantics as the Translation learner interface.
Do not overwrite or discard the learner's first Translation when repairing or reconstructing.
Do not make full reference comparison the mandatory immediate step after the first Translation attempt; minimal diagnosis/repair and learner reconstruction remain the preferred path.
Do not fabricate the three Current pending_review Translation references or remove their otherwise usable task/sets merely because reference coverage is partial.
Do not turn Writing into sentence-by-sentence review, template filling, or model-essay imitation; one complete composition remains the formal learner-facing unit.
Do not overwrite Writing first-draft evidence with revisions or treat same-prompt rewrite as mastery.
Do not treat synthetic QA/build success as real learner-use validation.
Do not create more governance files merely for completeness.

continuation_policy.update_when: Update at meaningful English shared-work stage transitions or when the active next action changes materially.
continuation_policy.fresh_chat_rule: Read main@HEAD CURRENT.md, this continuation file, content/english/LEARNING_CONTRACT.md, and only the Current owners needed for the active task. Objective work must additionally read objective-learning.md, objective-runtime.md, and objective-evidence-runtime.md. Translation work must additionally read modules/translation/learning.md. Writing work must additionally read modules/writing/learning.md. Continue from next_action rather than reconstructing the roadmap from prior chats.
